> @copilot 仔细检查，需要完成任务中所有的开发

Completed all three files specified in the issue scope:

1. **`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`** — `SpecQuickFilterItem`, `ObjectUIQuickFilterItem`, `QuickFilterItem` union type; both schemas updated to `QuickFilterItem[]`
2. **`packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`** — refactored to use shared `normalizeQuickFilters()` from core
3. **`packages/react/src/spec-bridge/bridges/list-view.ts`** — bridge now normalizes quickFilters at spec→SchemaNode transform time

Additionally extracted standalone `normalizeQuickFilter()` / `normalizeQuickFilters()` adapter functions into `@object-ui/core` (as required by the issue's "适配函数" requirement). Added 24 total tests across 3 test files — all 162 pass. Commits `e925818` and `ccb943c`.
